response.content:
The ledger does not support that claim.

Spend was **$1,274.28** from 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-07 and **$894.51** from 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-18. That is a decrease of **$379.77** (about 29.8% lower), not a quadrupling.

The ledger records no model, tool-version, or plan-setting changes around 2026-10-08 that could explain a spend increase; it only shows shifting model mix (claude-opus-5 rising from 56.5% to 74.9% of calls, claude-sonnet-5-5 falling from 41.5% to 23.2%). Because spend actually fell rather than quadrupled, the ledger cannot identify a cause for the increase you described.
